name: Sozai Search MCP
summary: MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients: search an index of 38,943 free 3D assets (Poly Haven, ambientCG, Kenney, Quaternius, KayKit, Polygonal Mind, 512 CC0 VRM avatars, NASA 3D, plus Quixel Megascans Fab listings) by keywords or meaning, preview them, and download GLB/VRM/PBR/HDRI files at real-world scale in metres. No GPU, API key or account. The tool hosts no files; downloads come from the official libraries.

access.notes: Code MIT. Assets keep own licences (mostly CC0; NASA models under NASA media guidelines: credit, no endorsement). Megascans are Fab-link only (Epic account, no redistribution). Kenney/Quaternius need kit-zip ingest. Brand/logo not MIT.

procedure: Install uv, then in your project register the server: claude mcp add sozai -s project -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/sozai-search-mcp sozai (Codex/Cursor take the same uvx command).
Start a new session and search for e.g. "wooden crate"; the first search downloads the published data index (~13.4 MB zip, 36,287 records).
Use fetch_asset to download from Poly Haven or ambientCG into a folder you name. For Kenney or Quaternius, download the official kit zip first and run sozai ingest.
Optional: run sozai semantic-setup (~350 MB EmbeddingGemma 2) for meaning search in any language.

stats.size: repo zip ~2.7 MB; data zip 14.7 MB
